status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Jacobs will undergo finger surgery Friday, and the Packers will have a better sense of his recovery timetable afterward, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: Jacobs exited Green Bay's Week 9 win over the Patriots after fracturing his ring finger and is in line to be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Vikings. A more precise recovery timeline is expected to be established after Jacobs undergoes surgery on the injured finger Friday, though initial estimates put his likely absence at 2-to-3 weeks on the optimistic side. MarShawn Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and Pierre Strong are currently available to handle Green Bay's backfield duties while Jacobs is sidelined, plus Chris Brooks (ankle) is a candidate to return from IR as soon as this weekend.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Brooks (IR, ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
status.longComment: Brooks suffered an ankle injury in the Week 4 meeting with the Buccaneers and eventually landed on injured reserve. While he's been working his way back since then, it's unknown if he will be ready for Sunday's divisional clash with the Vikings.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Moore (IR, ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
status.longComment: Moore has been working his way back from an ankle injury after last playing in the Week 5 meeting with the Bears. The wideout remains on injured reserve. While it's unclear if Moore will be ready to suit up Sunday versus the Vikings, it appears his return is imminent.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Williams (groin) was a limited practice participant Thursday.
status.longComment: Since Williams made his season debut in Week 6 against the Cowboys, his snap share has ranged from 48 to 60 percent over the last four games, and he's made his mark on offense in each one, gathering in 11 of 13 targets for 109 yards and one touchdown and taking eight carries for 44 yards. A groin issue has capped his reps so far this week, and Friday's injury report will determine if he has a designation ahead of Sunday's contest against the Vikings.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Whyle (concussion) remained sidelined at practice Thursday, Dominique Yates of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
status.longComment: Whyle faces an uphill battle to clear concussion protocol before Sunday's game against the Vikings. If he's unable to do so, he would sit out for a second consecutive game while Mark Redman and Jonnu Smith continue to function as the depth options behind Tucker Kraft.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Banks (knee/hip) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
status.longComment: Banks has played in the last three games for the Packers. While he's not a lock to suit up in Week 10 against Minnesota, he appears to be trending in the right direction. For now, the 29-year-old should be considered questionable, at minimum.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Glover (knee) was limited in Thursday's practice.
status.longComment: Glover wasn't available for the Week 9 win over the Patriots. Since he has practiced, albeit in a limited capacity, the door is open for a potential return in Sunday's divisional game against Minnesota. If Glover can't get back on the field, Laken Tomlinson could fill the void once again.

status.label: Questionable
status.longComment: Rhyan has missed the last two games because of an ankle injury. He didn't practice on Wednesday and Thursday, so unless he practices in at least a limited capacity Friday, he likely won't suit up for the Week 10 divisional showdown with the Vikings. If that's the case, John Williams would be in line for another start.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Zeitler (ankle/triceps) practiced in a limited capacity Thursday.
status.longComment: Zeitler logged a second consecutive limited practice session. If he can't suit up in Week 10 against the Vikings, Laken Tomlinson would likely fill the void.

status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: Coach Matt LaFleur said Thursday that he expects Brinson (calf) to play again at some point this season, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
status.longComment: Brinson suffered a calf injury during the preseason that forced him to miss the Packers' first three regular-season games before he was ultimately sent to injured reserve in early October. LaFleur also said Thursday that Brinson is recovering from a groin surgery, which could be a factor in his extended absence. Until he comes back from IR, Anthony Campbell figures to continue to see increased reps on the defensive line in his stead.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Van Ness (back) was listed as a DNP on Wednesday's practice report.
status.longComment: The Packers hosted a jog-through practice Wednesday, but Van Ness was a spectator for that session due to a back injury that he may have picked up during the Packers' Week 9 win over the Patriots, when he logged one solo tackle. He'll have two more opportunities to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's NFC North tilt against Minnesota.

status.label: PUP
status.shortComment: Parsons (knee/illness) practiced on a limited basis Thursday.
status.longComment: Despite dealing with an illness Wednesday, Parsons was able to go down as a limited participant in the ensuing jog-through, and he maintained that activity level one day later. He's seeking his first game action since Dec. 14, 2025, when he suffered a torn ACL in his left knee, and he so far has completed nearly two weeks of capped sessions since he was designated for return from the reserve/PUP list last Wednesday. Friday's injury report will reveal if Parsons has a chance to play Sunday against the Vikings, but more realistically the Packers likely are eyeing a road matchup with the Rams on Wednesday, Nov. 25 for his season debut.

status.label: Doubtful
status.longComment: Franklin has missed the last three games for the Packers. It appears the 30-year-old won't be back on the field in Week 10 versus the Vikings. If that's the case, Isaiah McDuffie remains in line for more snaps.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Hopper (chest) was a limited participant in Wednesday's jog-through practice.
status.longComment: Hopper picked up a chest injury during the first quarter of the Packers' win against the Patriots in Week 9 and did not return. The good news for the third-year pro is that he was cleared to practice in a limited fashion Wednesday. If Hopper can upgrade his participation over the next two days, then he would likely avoid an injury designation for Sunday's NFC North showdown against the Vikings.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Bullard (ankle) was held out of Wednesday's jog-through practice.
status.longComment: Bullard may have tweaked his ankle during the Packers' win over the Patriots in Week 9, when he logged three tackles (two solo). He'll have two more chances to return to practice ahead of Sunday's game against the Vikings, but if he cannot play in that contest, then Kamal Hadden, Carrington Valentine and Benjamin St-Juste would all be in line for more defensive snaps in the secondary.
